title: Instrument meal plan file and mutation services
description: Add structured debug logs to meal-plan file IO and the add/create mutation services, mirroring the shopping-list file patterns and including recipe/plan/serving context for service entry and exit.
acceptance_criteria: `MealPlanFiles.discover(in:)`, `readText`, `writeText`, and `plansURL(in:)` log the same boundary information pattern required for shopping lists.
`AddToMealPlanService.addToBlock`, `addNewBlock`, and `createNewPlan` log entry context including recipe URL, plan URL, servings, and scale factor where applicable.
The meal-plan service exits log success or error outcomes without introducing behavior changes.

handoff_summary.completed: Instrumented MealPlanFiles.discover, readText, writeText, and plansURL with entry/exit debug logs including file path, byte counts, and created-vs-reused subfolder status. Instrumented AddToMealPlanService.addToBlock, addNewBlock, and createNewPlan with entry logs (recipe URL, plan URL, servings, scale factor), warning logs on all error paths (readFailed, pathResolutionFailed, writeFailed, duplicatePlan), and debug exit logs on success. Added import os to both files.
handoff_summary.risks: SourceKit reported stale false-positive diagnostics (Loggers not in scope, No such module CookbookCore) that are pre-existing module-indexing artefacts in the worktree — identical pattern compiles in ShoppingListFiles.swift without issues.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent to validate logging output and confirm no behaviour regressions.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — changes are additive log calls only, no logic or API changes.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Followed ShoppingListFiles/AddToShoppingListService patterns exactly: Loggers.mealPlans category, [ClassName] method: entry/exit/warning format, privacy: .public on all interpolated user-visible strings, warning level for error paths and debug level for normal flow.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No behaviour changes introduced; logging only. Existing tests should pass unchanged.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: createNewPlan uses a direct serialised.write call (not MealPlanFiles.writeText) which is pre-existing; the writeFailed warning is placed inline around that call for consistency.

conflict_risks: None — changes are additive log calls only, no logic or API changes.

execution_history.summary: Added structured debug logging to MealPlanFiles and AddToMealPlanService, mirroring the ShoppingListFiles/AddToShoppingListService patterns. All boundary methods now emit entry/exit logs via Loggers.mealPlans with privacy: .public on interpolated values.
